_comment: Reviewed accepted-debt baseline for maxim.utils.audit (bugs ledger D19). Keyed by file::imported_module::scope with a count and the accepted symbol set — never by line. CI fails on findings not listed here, on a wider symbol set than accepted, on entries whose count or symbols exceed the live code (stale), and on UNREVIEWED entries. To accept new debt: add/extend the entry WITH a rationale. To burn debt down: fix the import and shrink/remove the entry in the same commit. `maxim --audit-architecture` lists the diff; there is no writer — edit this file by hand. Accepted debt should use `from X import name` — a bare `import maxim.x.y` records the module path as its only symbol and accepts every attribute, so the symbol check is vacuous for that shape (rejected by the gate's format test).

entries.rationale: compatibility re-export of ToolErrorKind (`# noqa: F401`) kept so `from maxim.agents.bus import ToolErrorKind` keeps working; in-package importers via agents.bus: runtime/executor.py and proprioception/pain.py (x2), plus the unit tests that pin the alias (tests/unit/test_tools_standalone_import.py and seven tool/pain tests) — migrate all of them to maxim.tools.base, then drop the re-export
